edges.relationship: Naver Cloud equity participation in and GPU infrastructure build-out for the National AI Computing Center SPV

contracts.signal: NAVER half-year report (filed 08-14-2026): for the National AI Computing Center project NAVER participates in the special-purpose company 'Korea AI Computing Center (KOACC)' established in June 2026, holding 26.06% (associate, carried at KRW 29,192,503K at 06-30-2026); total capital commitment KRW 104,400M, KRW 29,500M paid in H1 2026, KRW 74,900M remaining. In the same year NAVER Cloud was selected under the Ministry of Science and ICT's advanced-GPU procurement, construction and operation support programme to build and operate about 4,000 latest-generation GPUs.
contracts.units: 26.06% equity stake; ~4,000 GPUs under the MSIT programme
contracts.value: KRW 104,400M committed (KRW 29,500M paid, KRW 74,900M remaining at 06-30-2026)

edges.relationship: Neurocloud for HyperCLOVA X installed in the customer's own data center (closed-network generative AI)

contracts.signal: NAVER half-year report (filed 08-14-2026): 'Neurocloud for HyperCLOVA X' - cloud infrastructure installed inside the customer's data center so generative AI is trained on a closed network with no external data leakage - was supplied to Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power in 2024, followed by the Bank of Korea in 2025; used for in-house productivity and a company-specific language model. No contract value is disclosed.

edges.relationship: Neurocloud for HyperCLOVA X installed in the customer's own data center (closed-network generative AI)

contracts.signal: NAVER half-year report (filed 08-14-2026): the Bank of Korea adopted 'Neurocloud for HyperCLOVA X' in 2025 (after Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power in 2024) to run generative AI on an internal closed network and build a bank-specific language model; the filing says this is leading digital transformation in government and finance, with 2026 adoption talks expanding to defense, education and finance customers. No contract value is disclosed.

edges.relationship: 50/50 JV 'NAVER Innovation Company' delivering a map super-app and AI digital-twin platform for Saudi Arabia

contracts.signal: NAVER half-year report (filed 08-14-2026): NAVER Cloud and NHC Innovation (digital subsidiary of Saudi Arabia's National Housing Company) run the joint venture 'NAVER Innovation Company' (Saudi Arabia, 50% held by NAVER Cloud, carried at KRW 33,788,890K at 06-30-2026) which co-develops and operates a map-based super-app and AI digital-twin platform; digital twins of Makkah, Medina and Jeddah were completed by end-2025, covering about 6,800 km2 (11x the area of Seoul) and more than 920,000 precisely mapped buildings, with platform upgrades and wider Saudi roll-out in 2026. The JV generated KRW 3,586,339K of NAVER group revenue in H1 2026, carried a KRW 12,514,207K trade receivable at 06-30-2026 (KRW 8,218,298K at year-end) and received KRW 34,349,655K of capital contributions in H1 2026. The 2024 Saudi Ministry of Housing digital-twin programme and the SDAIA MOU on data centers and sovereign AI preceded the JV.
contracts.units: 3 cities (Makkah, Medina, Jeddah), ~6,800 km2, 920,000+ buildings mapped by end-2025
contracts.value: H1 2026 revenue from the JV KRW 3,586,339K; receivable KRW 12,514,207K at 06-30-2026; capital contributed KRW 34,349,655K in H1 2026
contracts.date_signed: 2024 (digital-twin programme start); JV in operation by 2025

edges.relationship: networking equipment financed under an asset-lease facility from Cisco Systems Capital

contracts.signal: NAVER half-year report (filed 08-14-2026), note 17 commitments (consolidated): at 06-30-2026 the group has an asset-lease facility with a limit of KRW 80,695M with Cisco Systems Capital and others, alongside KRW 1,353,000M of KRW loan facilities with 8 financial institutions. Equipment leased is not itemised; right-of-use machinery was KRW 18,360,577K and IDC buildings KRW 867,947,139K at 06-30-2026.
contracts.value: KRW 80,695M facility limit (drawn amount not stated)

edges.relationship: Vera Rubin GPU supply for regional AI cloud capacity

contracts.signal: NAVER half-year report (filed 08-14-2026), subsequent events and section XI: NAVER disclosed a forward business plan on 06-08-2026 (corrected 07-27-2026) under which NVIDIA will subscribe to a third-party allotment of about USD 1B of new NAVER common shares; the 07-27-2026 material report on the capital increase describes the NVIDIA-directed placement as funding 'a new AI Factory business', with payment by 10-30-2026 and listing of the new shares by 11-20-2026 as the contractual outside dates, subject to conditions precedent the company expects to satisfy earlier (terms still under negotiation and may change). Separately, in June 2026 NAVER Cloud became the first Korean company to join the NVIDIA-led open-model 'Nemotron Coalition' to co-develop upgrades to HyperCLOVA X.
contracts.units: third-party allotment of new NAVER common shares; Nemotron Coalition membership (June 2026)
